concerns.summary: Keying by event kind spreads one domain's events over partitions; the processor requires per-domain sequence order.
At-least-once with retries and no idempotency boundary double-charges renews.
No rollback or reconciliation during dual-write.
24 partitions may not sustain 5,000 events/s; the design should benchmark before committing.

questions.question: Is per-domain ordering needed by all consumers?
